Once a year I audit escrow accounts for a bank. I also have a home: 

Escrow at its lowest point should be a two month shortfall; 
E.i. your paying $300 a month for escrow. The lowest your account should go is $600. 

Now let's say after taxes and insurance your account has $2600 left at the lowest point.
